identificationModule.briefTitle: Intradermal Ipilimumab and Nivolumab in High Risk Stage II Melanoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Multicenter Phase 1b/2 Trial Testing Neoadjuvant Intradermal Ipilimumab and Nivolumab in High Risk Stage II Melanoma - MARIANE

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This open label, single country trial will test if local injection of low-dose ipilimumab and nivolumab, is safe and reduces the sentinel node positivity in high-risk stage II melanoma patients.

armGroups.label: A: 2x low dose intradermal
armGroups.description: 2 cycles of intradermal ipilimumab 0.5 mg + nivolumab 1 mg every 3 weeks

armGroups.label: B: 6x low dose intradermal
armGroups.description: 6 cycles of intradermal ipilimumab 0.5 mg + nivolumab 1 mg every week

armGroups.label: C: 2x higher dose intradermal
armGroups.description: 2 cycles of intradermal ipilimumab 10 mg + nivolumab 20 mg every 3 weeks

armGroups.label: D: intradermal + intravenous
armGroups.description: intradermal ipilimumab + nivolumab according to the optimal intradermal regimen plus 2 cycles of intravenous nivolumab 240mg every 3 weeks

primaryOutcomes.description: Feasibility as measured by the adherence to the timelines in the study protocol. A treatment arm will be declared as not feasible if 3/11 or 6/24 patients cannot adhere to the planned time of surgery due to treatment-related adverse events.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of effectiveness of the studytreatment
primaryOutcomes.description: Pathological response as assessed by blinded central review, adapted from the INMC criteria, including pCR, near-pCR, or pPR (0-50% residual viable tumor in resection material), or sentinel node negativity for melanoma.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Frequency and duration of all grade and grade 3-5, treatment-related adverse events according to CTCAE 5.0;.

defined as time from start of treatment to melanoma progression (irresectable stage II or III, or stage IV disease), melanoma recurrence, treatment-related death, or melanoma-related death, whichever occurs first;
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 5 years after start of treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: defined as time between date of surgery (re-excision and SN-procedure) and date of first distant metastasis, treatment-related death or melanoma-related death, whichever occurs first;
defined as time between date of start of treatment and date of death;
